_comment: Party Bond blessing and Party Traits (docs/PARTIES.md). tools/EspGen reads this to build the AG_PartyBlessing ability (one effect per bonus, gated by globals the DLL sets) and resolves the editor IDs into traits.resolved.json for the DLL. Changing an effect value needs an EspGen rebuild; the DLL shows the same numbers on the counter.
_range: A member only receives the blessing's own effects within this many game units of the player (about 60 m; a condition on the ability, checked by the engine). Who counts as present for Bond and affinities has no distance test: alive, following and loaded.
_maxActive: How many unlocked traits may be switched on at once (the first ones unlocked start on).
_blessing: Bond blessing, only while at least one member is present. Per Bond tier above Strangers: health and stamina regeneration (percent). armor: a flat armor rating while at least one member is present, however many there are.
_detect: How the DLL recognises vampires (a race keyword), werewolves (a faction, or the player's PlayerIsWerewolf global), housecarls, sellswords, the College, the Dawnguard and your spouse (factions).
_traits: Unlock conditions are fixed in the DLL (they count the player and the members present). damage: weapon damage percent. armor: armor rating (40 is about 5% less physical damage). magicResist: percent. carry: carry weight. healing: health regeneration and Restoration spell power, percent. magickaRegen: percent. health: points. skillRate: skills improve this percent faster (vanilla Well Rested is 10). goldRewards: percent more gold from the Adventurers Guild (applied by the DLL). days: in-field days a trait needs. targets: only against combat targets in these factions / with these keywords. Beast Buds replaces Creatures of the Night. APPEND new traits at the end: the order fixes their FormIDs.
